body.title: Add the codeReview.freshnessTimeoutMs config key
body.summary: Add an additive CONFIG_CATALOG entry { path:'codeReview.freshnessTimeoutMs', type:'number', default:120000, desc:'max ms the code-review freshness gate block-and-polls before re-prompting' } beside codeReview.enforce in src/config/config-catalog.ts. No existing config migrates; reconcileConfig carries it forward with the baked-in default.
acceptanceChecks: config-catalog.ts has a codeReview.freshnessTimeoutMs entry (type number, sensible baked-in default) beside codeReview.enforce
reconcileConfig surfaces the key with its default and honours a per-repo/global override, with no migration of existing config

tests.name: reconcileConfig carries codeReview.freshnessTimeoutMs with its baked-in default and honours a per-repo/global override
